$comment: Two components today: the JS package in js/ (fact-kit) and the aggregate facts package in facts/ (fact-kit-facts). Units are the keys of packages, so py/, rs/ and go/ join by adding an entry here and need no script change. A release/vX.Y branch carries the whole repository, cut-release.sh --units picks the units that board it, and scoped to the train this config holds only those. separate-pull-requests is false so the train gets a single Release PR with one changelog per unit; each unit keeps its own version and tag. Nothing is released from main.
